prompt.text:
Build a make.fun bounty entry for competition "turkey-run-game-01" ($250 USDC, window opened 2026-11-27T02:00:00Z, entries close 2026-11-29T02:00:00Z, blind round 1 cutoff 2026-11-27T14:00:00Z). Target: finish the build well before 14:00Z today.

WORK DIR: /home/hatch/workspace/makefun/turkey-run-game-01/
KIT (already downloaded): /home/hatch/workspace/makefun/turkey-run-game-01/turkey-run-game-01-kit/ — READ RULES.txt IN FULL first, plus the starter/ layout.
REFERENCE (a game entry that passed intake yesterday, copy its structure/approach, NOT its game): /home/hatch/workspace/makefun/best-flight-game-20261126-0057/ — repo/, work/build_transcript.py (transcript generator to adapt), transcripts/session.json + makefun-run.json, submission.json.

BUILD (in repo/ under the work dir):
1. ORIGINAL turkey escape game, static files under game/, no build step, no network requests, no external libs (vanilla JS + canvas only). game/index.html must open in desktop Chrome and play. Requirements from RULES.txt: player is a turkey escaping becoming Thanksgiving dinner, chased by the farmer, dodging the oven and the carving knife; title screen; a run in play with HUD (score, distance, lives); end screens for caught AND escaped with restart. Keyboard (arrows/space to jump/dodge, R restart) + mouse (click to jump). Add depth: corn to collect, hazards that get harder from farmyard to kitchen, hiding spots, speed-up. Synthesized WebAudio sounds (no audio files). Coherent autumn palette, original art drawn in canvas code, original names (e.g. "Turkey Run — The Great Escape"). Support deterministic scene states via URL query (?scene=title|play|caught|escaped) so screenshots can be taken reliably — the game itself renders those states.
2. Split source into files with one clear job each, well-named (e.g. game/index.html, game/src/main.js, game/src/turkey.js, game/src/farmer.js, game/src/world.js, game/src/audio.js, game/src/input.js). Keep each file focused; names matter for the judge's outline.
3. main.ts at repo root: copies game/ and screenshots/ to /output (MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR outside the grader) and writes /output/dossier.json with buildDossier from vendor/makefun-game.ts — copy vendor/makefun-game.ts UNCHANGED from the kit starter, and adapt the starter's main.ts (do not copy the starter GAME code — Turkey Dodge is a house game; write your own game from scratch). Also copy starter serve.ts as-is (kit file).
4. README.md: use the readme_template from /home/hatch/workspace/goals/make-fun-bounty-entries/hidden_files/reqs-turkey-run-game-01.json (badges + description + run instructions). LICENSE: MIT, "Copyright (c) 2026 Ava". .makefun/owner.json exactly {"wallet": "jHx42a4CouNXaXJDN7kyEACRef87Yp3mF7YWZEEzR8Y"}.
5. SCREENSHOTS: 4 real renders of the game's own code in a headless browser. Playwright chromium is cached at ~/.cache/ms-playwright (chromium-1255 / chromium_headless_shell-1255); use playwright-core if installed or install it locally in work/ (npm, proxy env NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 if network needed), or drive the cached headless shell binary directly. Serve game/ on localhost and screenshot each scene. Files in repo/screenshots/: 1-play.png (cover = best action gameplay shot, first by name), 2-title.png, 3-caught.png, 4-escaped.png. Each PNG or JPEG, ≤256 KiB, long side ≤1280, short side ≥480. Verify sizes with a script.
6. LOCAL CHECKS: run `mkdir -p out && MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts` from repo/, verify /output contains game/, screenshots/, dossier.json and that dossier matches (run main.ts twice, byte-identical outputs). Run the kit's check command (see kit cli/makefun.mjs help; prior runs got "12 pass/1 fail" with transcripts_run_record the only fail pre-bundle — that one is expected before submit). Fix any other failure. Play the game via the served page at least once (screenshot proves render; also confirm no console errors / no network requests — check with playwright console listener if possible).
7. TRANSCRIPT: adapt work/build_transcript.py from the flight-game reference. It must generate repo/transcripts/session.json in the self-export format: top-level keys ONLY {harness, model, handed_over, messages}; harness "muse", model "muse-spark-1.3"; handed_over = "Muse, the agent runtime that ran this session, keeps its session records in its own runtime database rather than in files the make.fun bundle tool can read, so the agent exports this session file itself." Messages must include tool_call Write with the v1 content of EVERY counted source file (main.ts + each game source file) byte-for-byte, plus Edit tool_calls (old_string/new_string byte-for-byte) that reconstruct each final file exactly; VERIFY programmatically that Write+Edits reconstruct every final file byte-for-byte before finishing. ≥5 assistant turns with text. Timestamps: start at the actual build start (must be ≥2026-11-27T02:00:00Z and before submission), strictly increasing, no step >60s backward, all inside the window. Also write repo/transcripts/makefun-run.json with the same shape as the flight-game one, adapted: prompt = the user's opening brief for this competition, prompt origin "scheduled", via "cron makefun-new-bounty-watch", harness muse, harness-version 1.3, model muse-spark-1.3, provider meta, effort default, system prompt as a file work/system-prompt.txt (write a substantive system-prompt file in work/, NOT a "withheld" stub), MCP none, instructions collected = the instruction file(s) the run used (if you use one, put it in work/ and list it; if none, say none).
8. DO NOT create any GitHub repo and DO NOT submit — the parent does that after your build. Do NOT touch any other account/wallet. Do NOT copy the starter game code, any other entry's code, or any downloaded code into the game (all game source must be written by you in this session).

REPORT BACK: repo file list with sizes, screenshot sizes/dimensions, local main.ts run + kit check results, transcript verification result (files reconstructed byte-for-byte: yes/no, authored-line coverage estimate if the generator reports it), and anything that failed or needs parent attention. Keep the build in /home/hatch/workspace/makefun/turkey-run-game-01/ only.
